name: Regulation (EU) 2022/868 on European data governance
description: Creates a framework to increase trust in voluntary data sharing by regulating 'data intermediation services' (neutral brokers connecting data holders and reusers), setting conditions for public-sector bodies to allow reuse of protected data (trade secrets, personal data, IP), and establishing 'data altruism' organisations for voluntary donation of data for the public good.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by European Union (europa.eu) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within European Union (europa.eu).
